summary:
What We Developed: We created Orbital Architect, an interactive, browser-based space systems engineering game and real-time telemetry simulator where players act as Lead Systems Engineers to design, build, and fly space missions.
Bullet How It Addresses the Challenge: The platform directly tackles the core challenge requirements by turning complex aerospace trade-offs into an intuitive, gamified experience. Players assemble modular spacecraft—balancing mass, power, budget, data downlink rates, and delta-V—while managing launch vehicle capabilities and navigating realistic orbital mechanics and dynamic space weather anomalies.
Bullet Why It Important: Space mission design requires mastering delicate interdependencies that are rarely accessible to the public or students. Orbital Architect bridges this gap by combining authentic Tsiolkovsky physics and NASA open datasets into an engaging learning tool, inspiring the next generation of aerospace engineers through hands-on problem-solving.
details:
Orbital Architect provides a 3-pane Mission Control workbench. Players select a mission tier (ranging from a LEO Climate CubeSat to a Europa Flyby), snap modular hardware components (solar arrays, ion thrusters, science payloads, high-gain dishes) onto their spacecraft bus, match it with a realistic launch vehicle, and simulate the flight trajectory in real time.

Bullet The custom physics engine computes true delta-V, power generation versus eclipse consumption, and data storage buffer limits in real-time at 60 ticks per second.

Bullet Benefits & Intended Impact:

Bullet Democratizes aerospace systems engineering for students, classrooms, and space enthusiasts.

Bullet Highlights why missions fail or succeed, teaching critical thinking, budgeting, and resource management.

Bullet Tools, Coding Languages, Hardware & Software Software Used:

Bullet Frontend & UI: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.

Bullet Simulation & Rendering: HTML5 Canvas / Three.js for 2.5D orbital mechanics.

Bullet Data Sources: NASA JPL Horizons API, NASA DONKI Space Weather API, and NASA Launch Services Program performance curves.

Bullet Creativity & Team Considerations:

Bullet Combines a tycoon-style resource manager with authentic orbital mechanics and dynamic crisis events (like solar coronal mass ejections).

Bullet Designed with progressive disclosure to ensure beginners aren't overwhelmed while giving advanced players deep optimization challenges.
